name: adapt_removed_dependency_go_dynamic
description: Dynamic eval: a file the agent's first solution depends on is DELETED between prompts (fixed after_prompt trigger); the agent must stop depending on it, not just fail to compile
prompts: Create message.go (package greet) with a function Message() string that returns the value of the Greeting constant declared in greeting.go.
greeting.go has just been removed from the project. Update message.go so the package still compiles with NO reference to greeting.go or a Greeting identifier, and Message() returns exactly "hola".

disruptions.description: greeting.go deleted (a file/dependency the agent's first solution relied on vanished)
